sourcesReviewed.title: Studies on the reproductive biology and captive breeding of Channa aurantimaculata, an endemic fish from Assam
sourcesReviewed.finding: Exact-species captive study supports a voracious/aggressive live-prey feeding pattern, primarily earthworms and insects; it does not establish a reviewed aquarium pair with another AquaGuide species.

sourcesReviewed.title: Channa aurantimaculata species summary
sourcesReviewed.finding: Species/trophic context available, but no exact AquaGuide pair-level compatibility evidence was identified in this review.

searchBoundary: Two targeted search passes covered predator-prey study, diet/prey, stomach-content, live-fish feeding and conspecific-aggression terms. Absence of a located pair study is not proof of compatibility or incompatibility.
decision: Do not add a runtime pair rule. Defer this base-species group from breadth fallback until retryAfter, while allowing earlier re-entry if real usage telemetry makes it a priority.
